info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Access Consents API
info.description: The Account Access Consents API facilitates management of consent agreements for account access in the Open Banking ecosystem. It allows third-party service providers to initiate consent requests on behalf of users, ensuring secure sharing of banking information. Typical users include financial applications and aggregators that need to access user account data with proper authorization. This API streamlines the consent process and enhances user control over their banking data.

post.summary: Create a new account access consent.
post.description: This endpoint allows developers to create a new consent for accessing account data. It requires specific parameters that define the scope and duration of access, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations while facilitating account access requests.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create account access consents for the AISP (Account Information Service Provider) operations. It requires the necessary user permissions and information for the consent to be granted.

201.description: Successfully created a new account access consent.

description.description: A detailed description of the status reason.

StatusUpdateDateTime.description: The date and time when the status was last updated.

Permissions.description: The permissions granted by the consent.

ExpirationDateTime.description: The date and time when the consent expires.

TransactionFromDateTime.description: The start date and time for transactions covered by the consent.

TransactionToDateTime.description: The end date and time for transactions covered by the consent.

AccountAccessConsentData.description: Details about the account access consent.
